\chapter{Capture-Path Hazards}
\label{app:capture}

The microphone array delivers two processed channels. Opening it as a single
channel downmixes them, and recognition degrades badly on utterances it
transcribes well from either channel alone. The pipeline therefore opens
both channels and selects one explicitly. Replies played through a separate
USB speaker reach the array acoustically. A test of the array's own output
was inconclusive, because nothing was connected to it, so whether its echo
canceller receives a playback reference is not established. The tables below
are generated from the capture-path measurements of 2026-09-15.
